families.title: Power from any two values (P, E, I, R)
families.widget: Power wheel: type any two of watts, volts, amps, ohms and it picks the formula and shows the working

families.title: RMS, peak, peak-to-peak and PEP
families.widget: Live sine wave: drag its height, read peak, peak-to-peak and RMS off the wave, put it across a 50-ohm load to get PEP

families.title: Decibels and the S meter
families.widget: Working S meter: tap two readings and see the dB gap and how many times more power it takes

families.title: Resistors, capacitors and inductors in series and parallel
families.widget: Parts bench: pick R, L or C, drop in values, flip series and parallel, and watch the total and the working (capacitors flip the rule)

families.title: Transformers and turns ratio
families.widget: Transformer: drag the turns on each winding and see voltage, current and impedance change (impedance goes as the square)

families.title: Reactance, impedance and resonance
families.widget: Frequency slider on a graph: the inductor line climbs, the capacitor curve falls, and where they cross is resonance

families.title: Antenna length (468 / f)
families.widget: Frequency slider with a drawn dipole or quarter-wave whip that stretches and shrinks, feet shown

families.title: FM deviation and bandwidth
families.widget: FM spectrum: slide deviation and audio tone for Carson's bandwidth; a multiplier chain shows deviation divided back to the oscillator

families.title: Link budget and link margin
families.widget: Signal path in dB: power, antenna gains and losses add up to what arrives; slide receiver sensitivity to see the margin

families.title: Mixers, IF and image response
families.widget: Mixer spectrum: slide the RF and oscillator, see sum and difference appear, and the image sitting twice the IF away

families.title: Intermodulation and the two-tone test
families.widget: Two tones on a spectrum: slide them and watch the odd-order products land right beside them

families.title: Sun to Earth: flares, CMEs and storms
families.widget: Sun-to-Earth timeline: launch a flare, a CME or a coronal-hole stream and watch when it arrives and what it does to HF

families.title: Sunspots, solar flux, K and A
families.widget: Sunspot slider that opens and closes the high bands, and a K vs. A chart (3-hour bars vs. the daily average)

families.title: MUF, LUF and the usable window
families.widget: Ionosphere cross-section: slide the frequency and takeoff angle and watch the ray get absorbed, come back, or punch through

families.title: D, E and F regions
families.widget: Same cross-section with a day/night switch: D soaks up low bands by day, E and F2 hops drawn at their real distances, NVIS straight up

families.title: Skip zone and scatter
families.widget: Cross-section showing the skip zone, then the weak, fluttery scatter that leaks into it

families.title: Short path vs. long path
families.widget: Beam heading dial on an azimuthal map: point short path, flip 180 degrees for long path, hear the echo when both arrive

families.title: Which sideband, and where it sits
families.widget: Band-edge tuner: pick a band (sideband is chosen by convention), turn the dial, and see the 3 kHz signal turn red if it spills past the edge

families.title: General privileges map
families.widget: Band chart (built for Technician): every HF band to scale with the General and Extra-only segments

families.title: Power limits and 60 meters
families.widget: Band chart of the HF bands with each band's power limit, the 30-meter 200 W exception and the 60-meter channel rules

families.title: Beacons
families.widget: Band chart with the beacon frequencies and the 28.2 to 28.3 MHz automatic beacon window marked

families.title: How wide is each signal
families.widget: Spectrum view: CW, RTTY, SSB, AM and FM side by side to scale, with a spacing ruler, a receiver filter you can widen, and an overmodulation switch that splatters

families.title: Mic gain, ALC and the speech processor
families.widget: Voice envelope on a scope: turn mic gain and the processor up and watch average power rise, ALC act, and peaks flat-top

families.title: AM, FM and PM: what changes
families.widget: Modulation scope: pick AM, FM or PM, slide the audio, and watch amplitude, spacing or phase of the RF change

families.title: Receiver tools: notch, blanker, NR, attenuator
families.widget: Receiver panel with a problem on the band (whistle, ignition pops, a blasting signal); switch on the right control and it clears

families.title: The waterfall and FT8
families.widget: Live waterfall: tap a trace to read it, see FT8's 15-second slots and why you answer in the other slot

families.title: RTTY and FSK
families.widget: Two-tone FSK display: 170 Hz shift, and flip the sideband to watch mark and space swap so nothing decodes

families.title: PSK31, QPSK and Varicode
families.widget: Phase wheel: tap bit pairs and watch QPSK jump 0, 90, 180, 270 degrees; type a word to see uppercase take more bits

families.title: ARQ, NAK and error correction
families.widget: Packet exchange: add noise, watch NAK and resends, too many tries drops the link; switch to FEC and redundancy fixes it

families.title: Winlink, gateways and mesh networks
families.widget: Network map: send an email through a gateway, then knock out a mesh node and watch the packet route around it

families.title: CW: Q signals and prosigns
families.widget: Match (pure vocabulary; nothing to calculate or move)

families.title: On-air etiquette
families.widget: Scenario: you are on the air and something happens; pick what you do

families.title: Rectifiers and power supplies
families.widget: Rectifier scope: switch half-wave, full-wave and bridge, add the filter capacitor, pull the plug to watch the bleeder drain it

families.title: Schematic symbols (Figure G7-1)
families.widget: Figure explorer (built for Technician) on Figure G7-1

families.title: Amplifier classes and efficiency
families.widget: Conduction viewer: pick Class A, AB, B or C and see how much of each cycle conducts, the efficiency, and which modes it can amplify

families.title: Digital logic: gates, counters, shift registers
families.widget: Logic bench: flip an AND gate's inputs, clock a 3-bit counter through its 8 states, clock bits down a shift register

families.title: Filter words: passband, cutoff, rejection
families.widget: Filter response curve: tap the passband, cutoff, skirts and floor to name each; drag the edges to see bandwidth between half-power points

families.title: SDR, I/Q and DDS
families.widget: Rotating I/Q phasor: two signals 90 degrees apart, and the software blocks that do the rest

families.title: Diodes, transistors and tubes
families.widget: Bias slider: germanium and silicon diodes switch on at 0.3 and 0.7 V, an LED lights forward, a transistor switch snaps between cutoff and saturation

families.title: Capacitor, resistor and ferrite types
families.widget: Sort (these are look-alike part types with one fact each; nothing to slide)

families.title: RF connectors
families.widget: Frequency chart: each connector's bar runs up to its limit (RCA low, BNC 4 GHz, SMA several GHz, N to 10 GHz)

families.title: RF in the shack: grounds, bonding and chokes
families.widget: Ground wire slider: when the wire is a quarter wave long the chassis end goes RF hot; then fix hum and hot spots by bonding and chokes

families.title: AC wiring, breakers and lightning
families.widget: Breaker panel: match wire gauge to breaker size, see which of the four wires get fused, and trip a GFCI with a leak to ground

families.title: RF exposure
families.widget: Time-averaging meter: slide duty cycle and power and watch the average exposure against the limit

families.title: SWR, mismatch and line loss
families.widget: Feed line simulator: slide the load impedance for SWR, add line loss and watch the SWR at the radio look better than it is, add a tuner

families.title: Feed line types and loss
families.widget: Line builder: slide wire spacing, wire size, length and frequency; only spacing and size move the impedance, frequency moves the loss

families.title: Feed point impedance: height, feed point, radials
families.widget: Dipole lab: lower the dipole, slide the feed point toward the end, droop a ground plane's radials, and watch the impedance meter

families.title: Radiation patterns
families.widget: Pattern viewer: pick an antenna (dipole, ground plane, halo, small loop, Yagi) and see its pattern from above, with height for the dipole

families.title: Yagi design and stacking
families.widget: Yagi builder: add directors on a longer boom, fatten elements, stack two, and watch gain, beamwidth and bandwidth

families.title: Short and loaded antennas
families.widget: Mobile whip: shorten it, then add a loading coil or capacitance hat to bring it back to resonance and watch the bandwidth shrink

families.title: Mobile, battery and solar power
families.widget: Solar builder: string 0.5 V cells in series and parallel, connect a battery, then turn the sun off to see why the diode is there

families.title: Exams, VEs and upgrades
families.widget: Upgrade timeline: drag days since you passed and see the AG suffix, CSCE expiry at 365 days and the 2-year grace period

families.title: Remote operation, third party and ITU regions
families.widget: Scenario: pick where you are and where the station is, and see whose rules apply and what third-party traffic can go
